system.effect:
You become Trained in this Culture. Use your Origin Constellation’s Proficiency Bonus for its checks. Each Talent in this Constellation contributes to your Origin Constellation’s Proficiency Rank.

You were raised in Kestrel Reach.

You know the Common and Reachspeak languages.

You gain a +1 Condition bonus to Diplomacy checks toward those who share the same Culture.
system.description: Reachers thrive where people and possibilities meet, building livelihoods through sharp observation, useful introductions, and bargains worth making again.
system.automation:
[LANGUAGE Common, Reachspeak]
[EFFECT CHECK: 1 condition, diplomacy; IF: CLAIM(toward someone who shares your Culture)]

claim.text: toward someone who shares your Culture
